mechanism: Echinacea may induce CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 enzymes, potentially reducing hydroxychloroquine plasma concentrations, while both agents have immunomodulatory properties that could theoretically conflict in certain disease states.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of hydroxychloroquine; counsel patients to avoid concurrent use in autoimmune conditions where immunosuppression is therapeutic goal; consider alternative herbal supplements.
